title: Battle of Hòa Bình ends in defeat for French forces by the Việt Minh in Vietnam.
text: The Battle of Hòa Bình was fought during the First Indochina War. It occurred from 10 November 1951 to 25 February 1952, when French Union forces attempted to lure the Việt Minh out into the open and to force it to fight on French terms.

title: Operation Bretagne begins in Vietnam.
text: Operation Bretagne was a French Union military operation between 1 December 1952 and 4 January 1953, during the First Indochina War. Four Mobile Groups and General de Berchoux's two Amphibian Sub-Groups hunted and engaged the 9th Regiment (304th Division) and the 48th Regiment (320th Division) of the Viet Minh, who were threatening the bishopric of Bui Chu, in Nam Định province.

title: Alain Bombard begins to sail from Canary Islands to Barbados in 65 days; he reaches them 23 December.
text: Alain Bombard was a French biologist, physician and politician, famous for sailing across the Atlantic Ocean in a small boat without provisions. In 1951, while working as a physician, he was unable to save the victims of a shipwreck.

title: Operation Lorraine begins.
text: Operation Lorraine was a French military operation of the First Indochina War.

title: Battle of Nà Sản begins.
text: The Battle of Nà Sản was fought between the French Union and the Việt Minh at Nà Sản, Sơn La Province, during the First Indochina War for control of the T’ai region in Northwest Vietnam. The battle ended with the victory of the French Union.
